Dairy/Dairy Alternatives: Low-fat Greek yogurt, skim milk, or fortified plant-based milk alternatives (almond, soy) fortified with Vitamin D and calcium

foods_to_avoid: Refined Grains: White bread, white rice, regular pasta, sugary cereals
Added Sugars: Sugary drinks (soda, sweetened teas, fruit juices with added sugar), candies, pastries, desserts

Unhealthy Fats: Foods high in saturated fats (fatty cuts of red meat, processed meats like bacon/sausage, full-fat dairy products, butter, coconut oil, palm oil), trans fats (fried foods, many commercially baked goods, some margarines)
